subject.title: feat(doctor): add narrow deterministic gating check

question: Should the doctor lint tests run in the always-on check-guards shard, or should this PR stay limited to the comparator and source regression test?
rationale: The comparator fix is a code-path judgment, but adding recurring CI work changes automation cost and failure surface in a way the diff alone cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the guard after proof
options.body: Resolve conflicts, add tied-finding real behavior proof, and keep the check-guards command if CI owners want this invariant enforced there.

options.title: Keep source tests only
options.body: Land the comparator and regression test while removing the workflow command if this coverage belongs in normal test lanes.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until the contributor refreshes the branch and demonstrates the changed ordering behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the guard after proof
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, add tied-finding real behavior proof, and keep the check-guards command if CI owners want this invariant enforced there.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this account to the CI workflow and workflow-guard surfaces changed by the PR.
